shadows.name: working-surface
shadows.purpose: Lift the white research surface from the cool ground.

motion.name: desk-reveal
motion.purpose: Small view transition; disabled for reduced motion.

narrative.overview: Selected findings, charts and qualitative facts form the module reading view; supporting analysis expands in place, with exact source rows beside it and technical traceability in Evidence & audit.

rules.name: Availability is not acceptance
rules.body: Module availability uses explicit neutral labels; blue marks selection, action and issuer series. File presence is never acceptance.

rules.name: Curated module reading
rules.body: Lead with selected analytical sections. Keep interpretation qualifications visible; expand supporting details and limitations. Load execution requests, source inventories and downstream handoffs only when Evidence & audit is opened. Preserve the complete retained output.

dos: Keep values, periods and source identities visible.
donts: Do not invent analytics to fill a visual.
